 Win Free Passes to See The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Early in Florida
 Published Nov 13, 2026 05:15 PM EST 
 · Updated Nov 13, 2026 06:23 PM EST 
 · 
 By 
 Emily R Hazlett 
 · 
 4 MIN READ 
 Entries close November 16, 2026 at 12:00:00 PM Eastern Time. 
 Joseph Zada portrays young Haymitch Abernathy as Peacekeepers oversee the reaping in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. Photo courtesy of Lionsgate. All Rights Reserved. FlickDirect and Lionsgate are offering free advance screening passes in Miami, Orlando, and Tampa on November 16, four days before the new Hunger Games film arrives in theaters.
 Before Katniss Everdeen volunteered as tribute, another District 12 resident was forced into an arena that would change his life forever. The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping takes audiences back to the 50th Hunger Games and the story of a young Haymitch Abernathy. FlickDirect and Lionsgate are giving Florida movie fans the opportunity to see the film early, with free advance screenings on Monday, November 16, in Miami, Orlando, and Tampa.
 Set 24 years before the events of the original Hunger Games , the film follows 18-year-old Haymitch (Joseph Zada) as he prepares to spend his birthday with the girl he loves, Lenore Dove Baird (Whitney Peak). Instead, his name is called at the reaping, sending him into the Second Quarter Quell, a special edition of the Games in which the Capitol doubles the number of tributes to 48.
 Haymitch enters the arena alongside fellow District 12 tributes Maysilee Donner, Wyatt Callow, and Louella McCoy. With the odds stacked against him and the Capitol determined to make a spectacle of the competition, he must decide how far he's willing to go to survive without surrendering who he is.
 Francis Lawrence returns to direct the latest installment of the franchise, based on Suzanne Collins' novel. The cast includes Joseph Zada, Whitney Peak, Mckenna Grace, Jesse Plemons, Elle Fanning, Kieran Culkin, Ralph Fiennes, and Glenn Close.
 The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens in theaters Friday, November 20, 2026. Florida audiences can get an early look at the film four days before its theatrical release.
 The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Free Screening Details
 All three advance screenings take place on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 7:30 PM EST . Choose your preferred city and follow the corresponding link to claim your complimentary passes.

 How to Claim Your Free Screening Passes
 Getting your passes is simple. Select your preferred city above, visit the Lionsgate screening website, and follow the instructions to claim your complimentary admission while passes remain available.
 No email entry through FlickDirect is required. The screening provider distributes passes directly on a first-come, first-served basis.
 IMPORTANT: Screening passes are limited and do not guarantee admission. Seating is first-come, first-served and subject to theater capacity. Early arrival is strongly encouraged.
 Official Screening Giveaway Rules
 NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Free advance screening passes are available while supplies last to eligible U.S. residents who meet applicable theater admission and age requirements. Screenings take place November 16, 2026, at 7:30 PM EST at AMC Aventura, AMC Altamonte, and AMC Veterans. Passes must be obtained through the designated Lionsgate screening links. Duplicate or fraudulent claims may be rejected. Employees of FlickDirect Inc., Lionsgate, participating theaters, promotional partners, their agencies, affiliates, and immediate families or households are ineligible. Passes are valid only for the selected screening, have no cash value, are nontransferable, and may not be resold. Admission is first-come, first-served and subject to theater capacity, venue policies, and possible overbooking. A pass does not guarantee seating. Early arrival is strongly encouraged. Attendees are responsible for transportation, parking, and other personal expenses. Screenings may be changed or canceled without notice. Void where prohibited by law.
